about.title: Montebello Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a fatal crash happens along SR-60, Beverly Boulevard, or Whittier Boulevard, the people left behind face grief alongside confusing legal questions. Los Angeles County records show these corridors carry heavy traffic, and Friday evening hours between 5 and 7 p.m. see the most reported collisions in Montebello. A wrongful death claim is separate from any criminal case that may follow a fatal crash, and it exists to help surviving family members address the financial and emotional toll of losing a loved one. California law limits who may bring this type of claim, so understanding your standing matters early on. LawProactive doesn't practice law ourselves — we connect grieving families with an independent personal injury attorney who can review the circumstances of the crash, explain your options, and pursue a claim on a contingency basis, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery.

items.title: Standing Is Limited by Law
items.desc: California law restricts who can file a wrongful death claim, generally prioritizing a spouse, domestic partner, or children, with other dependents or heirs eligible in certain situations. An attorney can help clarify who qualifies before any filing decisions are made.

items.title: The Clock Starts at Two Years
items.desc: Families generally have two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim in California, though claims involving a government entity carry a much shorter deadline. Acting sooner rather than later helps preserve evidence tied to Montebello roadways like SR-60.

items.title: Recoverable Losses Go Beyond Bills
items.desc: California law allows recovery for tangible costs like funeral expenses and lost financial support, as well as intangible losses such as companionship and guidance. An independent attorney can help document both categories accurately.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Typically, a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children have first priority to file. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may have standing under California law. An attorney can review your family's specific situation to confirm eligibility.

items.question: How long do we have to file after a fatal crash in Montebello?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. If a government entity, such as a public road authority, may be involved given a location like SR-60 or Beverly Boulevard, the deadline can be significantly shorter. It's important to speak with an attorney as soon as possible to protect your options.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as a criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No, they are separate matters. A criminal case is brought by the state and focuses on punishment, while a wrongful death claim is a civil action pursued by the family to address financial and emotional losses. One can proceed independently of the other's outcome.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge families for this service?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service that connects grieving families with an independent personal injury attorney. Attorneys in the network typically work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless there's a recovery.
